name: campaign_20260805
status: training in flight; no scientific conclusion available or claimed

declaration.question: Does the strongest calibrated family continue improving on the 26,624/6,656 pilot bank when given further 20-epoch segments, and does the ordering between families survive being given comparable numbers of epochs?
declaration.rule: after a segment, continue the same family when latest_epoch - best_epoch <= 6, otherwise advance
declaration.owner_naming_correction: the owner named a third family 'lr1e5', which does not exist; asked which of the four was meant, they answered lr3e5

excluded.calibrated_lr1e4: owner's instruction; 39 epochs already, and its dicos-p10 epoch-40 checkpoint is ARTIFACT QUARANTINED and not a valid parent

boundary.comparability: every segment uses the energy-scaled closure tolerance declared 2026-08-05, so these segments are a new declared experiment relative to any run frozen before it

parent_last_epoch_semantics: parent_last_epoch is the BEST epoch, not the last, because the resume continues from the best checkpoint. For the half-batch family those differ (21 vs 22) and using the last would have shifted its horizon by one.

defects.error: ValueError: run directory must be a safe workdir-relative path (dicos_diag_producer.py:50 resolve_under <- :309 main)
defects.cause: the supervisor passed absolute --run-dir and --wrapper-log; the producer resolves both under the workdir and refuses anything that escapes it
defects.why_it_was_invisible: producer_started had already been logged with its pid, and nothing waits on the producer until the trainer exits, so it sat as [python] <defunct> while everything else looked correct
defects.consequence_if_undetected: the campaign would have trained for hours with no checkpoint ever reaching the 3090
defects.detected_by: reading the process tree rather than the log
fix: verify producer liveness five seconds after launch; a dead producer terminates the trainer and aborts the segment

defects.cause: CBSC_ZDC_SHARD_CACHE was not set in the trainer environment
defects.precedent: this is the slow-loader configuration that got dicos-r2 archived as aborted_r2_slow_loader
defects.symptom: GPU at 487 MiB and 0% utilization with the model loaded and four loader workers at ~85% CPU - starving, not stalled
defects.note: a transport property, admitted only after byte-identity was proven over 400 samples through both cache sizes (4ba4d7a713c9c1a574a5f27857a5fe46d8fe1e4a7fa8f456692ea4d367507c9b)

stop_procedure: supervisor killed first so it could not observe the trainer exit and start a second segment
self-match-safe /proc scan confirmed holders: NONE BEFORE anything was moved, because a live process resolves paths per write and would follow the directory
aborted_segment.comparability: dicos-c-01 produced no epochs and must not be compared against anything

live_segment.resume_note: the p7 epoch-22 best, staged to BOTH resume slots
live_segment.frozen_config_reused: regenerated byte-identically, so the idempotent path reused it rather than overwriting a frozen config
fixes_verified_live: producer pid present in the process tree and not defunct

config_delta_guard.mechanism: the supervisor reads its own diff against the parent frozen config and refuses to launch if anything outside an explicit allowlist moved
config_delta_guard.rationale: an unattended process freezes configs with nobody watching the diff, so the diff has to be read by the process
config_delta_guard.pinned_by: tests/test_campaign.py, including that the allowlist contains no scientific value

autonomous_on_dicos: per-epoch 3090 diagnostics namespaced by run tag

not_autonomous.public_website: the pods have no Node, so the site cannot be built there
not_autonomous.push_or_publication_from_a_pod: the only writable directory on DiCOS is the multi-tenant project workdir and HOME is not writable, so a credential file would have to live where other tenants can read it
not_autonomous.exhibition_figures: the builders write into exhibition/current/, so running them inside the pod repo checkout would dirty the clean tree that the pre-launch gate and every git pull depend on

autonomy.mitigation: scripts/refresh_campaign_outputs.py rebuilds the whole local picture from the campaign's own recorded state with no arguments, so the arguments that change every segment cannot be got wrong

cost.accounting: ASGC SRUs; no paid cloud compute
